text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh... That's strange. I could've sworn 
someone called my name.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, the Three Goddesses? ...Just 
kidding!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, brings back memories... In France, I 
used to look up at the Goddess statues 
just like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A sculpture of the Goddess of Victory 
bestowing a laurel wreath... I thought, 
"someday, I'll..."
